correctness.rationale: The all-pairs permutation distance formula is checked against 24 breadth-first searches; the 24-vertex graph has 72 edges, is bipartite and connected. The exact full scale-two face set has 9,904 faces. A deterministic codimension-one matching contains 4,935 disjoint pairs and precisely one critical 0-cell and 33 critical 3-cells. Every one of 56,328 Hasse incidences is oriented, and a complete topological sort certifies acyclicity. Forman discrete Morse theory implies a CW complex with one point and 33 three-cells, all trivially attached, hence the indicated wedge; direct mod-two boundary ranks corroborate but do not establish homotopy. The endpoints follow from diameter three and bipartiteness. All variables, quantifiers, and inclusive boundary conventions are stated.

value.rationale: The graph is the canonical full-transposition Cayley/absolute-length metric on S4, the first nontrivial order beyond the S3 diameter-two filtration. Its radius-two flag complex has 9,904 faces spanning dimension 11 but has unexpected simple homotopy type of 33 three-spheres. A finite exact full homotopy classification, field-independent persistence, and an executable acyclic-matching certificate form a mathematically motivated benchmark not deducible from graph counts or individual Betti numbers. This is a finite classification with natural object/invariant motivation, not a claim about all symmetric groups.
